title: Game Night ABC
hook: Winning is one outcome; playing the rule fairly is the shared job.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D playroom storybook, rounded safe toys, simple uncluttered scenes; visual identity: Game Night ABC

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing structured games with free play
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: rule-neutral retrieval -> target -> quiet turn gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Game Night ABC about rules and turn structure: free play, puzzles, card games, tossing games and riding toys are distinguished; not every toy belongs in a seated game night.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child asks 'what makes this a game—goal, rule, turn, or challenge?' and moves non-game objects to comparison cards.
